# BioSense Africa

> Connected livestock monitoring designed for African farmers.

BioSense brings animal temperature and activity signals together with farmer alerts. Contact the team to discuss local rollout, pilot opportunities, and agricultural partnerships.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://biosenseafrica.com/): Platform overview and mission.
- [Product](https://biosenseafrica.com/product): Biosensor tag, connectivity, and proposed specifications.
- [Contact](https://biosenseafrica.com/contact): Waitlist, pilot, and partner enquiries.
- [Field notes](https://biosenseafrica.com/blog): Published updates and stories.
